operating_notes.text: The group operates in one segment, manufacturing and trading of plastic pipes, fittings and allied products.
The company acquired an additional 4.35% of Kisan Mouldings Limited for ₹14.76 Cr, raising its holding from 57.59% to 61.94%.
A provision of ₹127.51 lakh was recognised for incremental liability from the four Labour Codes notified on 21 November 2025.
FY26 sales volume 1,03,752 MT (+4% YoY) while revenue fell 6% to ₹1,104.9 Cr, indicating lower realisations.
Kisan Mouldings (61.94% held) posted Q4FY26 revenue of ₹81 Cr and EBITDA of -₹1 Cr.
Total capacity 240,000 Ton across 7 plants; target 288,000 Ton in two years.
Company targets ₹400 crore plus revenue for Q1 FY27.
Q1FY27 sales volume flat YoY due to extreme price drop in April, with recovery starting from May onwards
Varanasi plant target is to utilize 30% capacity in FY27, 50-60% in FY28 and 70% in FY29
Window profile business expected to contribute 7-8% to revenue in FY27, gradually improving to 10% at full capacity
